body:
Founder real-time direction: "we need to processify that" (re: gpt2 serve.py + broker manual
restarts). Built and enabled two new systemd --user units, both Type=simple/Restart=on-failure/
WantedBy=default.target, matching the existing fatbaby-*.service pattern:

- gpt2-serve.service (gpt2-alpine-c/ops/systemd/gpt2-serve.service) — serve.py on :8088
- fatbaby-broker.service (PRRJECT_FATBABY/ops/systemd/fatbaby-broker.service) — broker on :8679,
  routes at gpt2-alpine-c/config/broker-routes.json

Killed the manually-nohup'd processes from earlier in this session, verified both units start
cleanly via daemon-reload + enable --now, confirmed PPID=systemd (not a login shell), confirmed
both listening and serve.py health check passing. REBOOT_RUNBOOK.md updated to remove these from
the manual-restart list; also corrected a stale doc claim that cmd/broker's source lived in
gpt2-alpine-c (it's actually PRRJECT_FATBABY/cmd/broker).

Commits: PRRJECT_FATBABY 8216962, gpt2-alpine-c e732e36.

Known issue carried forward, not fixed by this change (separate scope): cmd/broker's 30s
upstream timeout is shorter than serve.py's real cold-inference latency (~8min observed),
so the broker path still 502s on real generation calls. Documented in the runbook and in
Apple #13254.
title: Processified gpt2 serve.py + broker into real systemd units
